author: Samsung
description:
This is the official video introducing the less noise feature of Hylex, Samsung's new cooling & heating system. The video showcases how Hylex helps create a quieter and more comfortable home environment by reducing outdoor unit noise — especially at night, when peace and quiet matter most. As homeowners spend more time enjoying their indoor and outdoor living spaces, the demand for low-noise home comfort continues to grow.

Hylex is designed to deliver peaceful cooling and heating with less disturbance to you and your neighbors.

Whether you're relaxing at night, enjoying time in the backyard, or simply looking for a quieter home environment, Hylex helps create a more comfortable outdoor living experience.

Q: How can I reduce the outdoor unit noise at night?
A: With Night Silence Mode of Hylex, you can reduce operational noise levels through adjustable low-noise settings. 

Enjoy quiet comfort — day or night.
